'''Lora''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], Lora believed that the [[Rakata/Legends|original architects]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] must have used some kind of teleportation system to move throughout the massive prison. She tasked a Republic spacer to scan several Rakata terminals so she could analyze the technology.<ref name="TOR" />
